title: Agent vision: default-on screenshots, dynamic camera/geo/tile capture, camera read-back (+ agent_input_surface folded in)
description: Screenshots on by default (FE_API_SCREENSHOT_ALLOW unset = on, =0 = off; Owner + rate limit kept; headless stays disabled) via a per-gate default on OperatorGate. New POST /api/v1/debug/screenshot (GET unchanged) and matching MCP params: window mode (optional pose on the main camera, settle, capture, restore) or scene mode (off-screen render-to-texture camera, no UI, user view untouched). Pose = exactly one of camera/orbit/geo/tile/focus; strict finite+range validation through a validate-once newtype; resolved pose returned as X-FE-Capture-Pose header / MCP text part. New GET /api/v1/debug/camera + MCP get_camera for closed-loop agents. Terrain streaming becomes multi-focus so scene captures stream their own tiles. Executes agent_input_surface_20261031 (synthetic input, default OFF) in the same program.
origin: user directive 2026-10-31: enable screenshot support by default, make it dynamic (camera, tile coordinates etc.), fold in the recent session's context
alignment: Public seam S-AGENT-GUI (conductor/open-core.md). Agent QA capability usable by any self-hoster; no business logic.
